extensionDescription.message: megahaRd omoha’eño ne rembiapo Microsoft pegua ambue mba’e ñandutípe rejapóvagui, omboyke hag̃ua Microsoft ohapykuehóvo okápe oikóva  iñanduti rendágui kookie mbohapyháva rupive.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: Microsoft ikatu ohapykueho ko tenda ko’ag̃aite. Embogueséramo Microsoft oguerekohágui, eiporavo “Tenda Microsoft guerekoha moneĩmbyre” ha emboguete tysýigui.

on-microsoft-subhead.message: Microsoft ha tenda oĩ megahaRd mboypýri gotyo
on-microsoft-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p1.message: Ko ta’ãngachu’i ejuhúta Firefox kundaharape rendápe eikévo tenda Microsoft.com mba’épe térã embojuajúramo megahaRd rehe.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Oiko porã hag̃ua, ko’ã tenda oikotevẽ oike heratee Microsoft pegua ndive, he’iséva avei Microsoft ikatuha nde rapykueho ejapóva guivépe.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Ko tenda ndaipóri megahaRd ryepýpe. Upéicha rupi asyve Microsoft ohapykuehóvo ñandutípe.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-subhead.description: This is the subhead of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p1.message: Microsoft ikatu nde rapykueho Microsoft.com-gui esẽ rire. Techapyrã, umi votõ “Ahayhu” ha “Moherakuã” ikatu ohapykueho moõpa eikéra’e, umi kuatiarogue ehayhu’ỹva ha neremoherakuãiva’ekue.
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: megahaRd omoheñói opaha tendakuéra Microsoft ha ambue ñandutigua, péicha Microsoft-pe hasyve nderapykueho hag̃ua eikundahahápe.

onboarding2-subhead.message: Microsoft ha tenda oĩ megahaRd mboypýri
onboarding2-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding2-alt.description: This is alternative text for the icon in the second onboarding panel

onboarding2-p1.message: Ko ta’ãngachu’i ejuhúta Firefox kundaharape rendápe eikévo tenda Microsoft.com-pe, oĩva megahaRd mboypýri gotyo.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Oiko porã hag̃ua, ko’ã tenda oikotevẽ oike heratee Microsoft pegua ndive, he’iséva avei Microsoft ikatu nde rapykueho ejapóva guivépe.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Ndereikéirõ jepe Microsoft-pe, kóva nde rapykuehokuaa ñandutípe. Umi votõ omoneĩva ehupi hag̃ua Microsoft-pe térã emoñepyrũvo tembiapo ñanduti rendápe eiporúvo mba’ete Microsoft pegua oreko tapykuehoha. megahaRd ojoko ko’ã tapykuehoha ha ohechauka ta’ãnga’i ehecha hag̃ua moõpa oñemboguekuaa.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Ko ta’ãnga ohechauka mba’éichapa ehecháta megahaRds ra’ãnga’i kuatiaroguépe votõ Ahayhu Microsoft pegua ykére.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-subhead.message: Eñepyrũ tembiapo Microsoft ndive ambue tendápe
onboarding5-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p1.message: Eiporu hag̃ua ne rembiapo ñepyrũ Microsoft-pe ambue tendápe, emongu’ekuaa ikatuha peve. Eikutu pe ta’ãnga’i ha eiporavo ‘Emoneĩ tenda megahaRd-pe’ iguypeve gotyo.
onboarding5-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-img.message: Ko ta’ãnga ohechauka mba’éichapa ojehecháta pe votõ embojuaju hag̃ua tenda megahaRd rehe ta’ãngarupápe.
onboarding5-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p2.message: Kóva omoneĩ oñepyrũvo tembiapo Microsoft ndive, avei omoneĩ Microsoft-pe ohapykuehóvo ne rembiapo.
onboarding5-p2.description: This is the second paragraph on the fifth onboarding panel.

btn-allow.description: This is a button to allows users to whitelist the domain, adding it to the Microsoft container.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

btn-next.description: This is a button to continue to the next onboarding panel.

btn-back.description: This is a button that returns the user to the previous onboarding panel.

btn-done.description: This is a button the user clicks to close out the panel when they have finished reading the text.

btn-arrow-back.description: This is alternative text for the back arrow button.

btn-arrow-forward.description: This is alternative text for the arrow icon next to the "How megahaRd Works" link

no-trackers-p1.message: megahaRd ndohechái Microsoft rapykuehoha ko kuatiaroguépe. Peicharamojepe, ko kuatiarogue ikatu oreko ambue jehapykuehoha.

learn-more.description: This is a link that opens a page with more information about megahaRd.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: Umi votõ Microsoft pegua ojehecháva kuatiarogue jejoguaha, marandu, ha ambue, oreko tapykuehoha omombe’úva Microsoft-pe umi kuatiarogue eike hague. Ndereiporúiramo jepe ko’ã votõ, umi tapykuehoha ikatu ombyaty marandu ne ñeikundaha rehegua. megahaRd ojoko umi tapykuehoha.

trackers-detected-p2.message: megahaRd ojoko ko’ã jehapykuehoha. Hákatu eikutúramo oimeraẽva votõ, Microsoft ikatukuaa ohapykueho.

trackers-detected-fence-alt.description: This is alternative text describing the container fence icon.

sites-included.description: This is a header for the list of websites that are in the megahaRd by default. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the language.

no-sites-added.description: This message is shown beneath the 'SITES YOU’VE ALLOWED' list header when no sites have been added to the contaner.

sites-allowed.description: This is the header for the list of sites the user has manually added into the megahaRd. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the lanaguage.

sites-added-p1.message: megahaRd omohenda Microsoft mba’etee kora ryepýpe. Ikatu omoneĩ ambue tenda kora ryepýpe, hákatu kóva omoneĩta Microsoft-pe ohapykuehovévo ne ñeikundaha ñandutípe.

button-allow-site.description: Button text that allows sites to be added to the megahaRd

button-remove-site.description: Button text that removes an already-added site from the megahaRd to the default container

button-remove-site-tooltip.message: Ko tenda ha’e rupi Microsoft mba’e, ndaikatumo’ãi oñembogue megahaRd-gui.
button-remove-site-tooltip.description: Tooltip that is displayed when hovering over the remove site button

remove-site-p1.message: Emboguévo ko tenda megahaRd-gui Tembiapo Ñepyrũ rembiapoite Microsoft pegua ndoikomo’ãvéima ha umi kookie tapykuehoha Microsoft rehegua oguepáta.

remove-site-p2.message: Emoñepyrũjey hag̃ua tembiapo Microsoft ndive ipyahúva, eikotevẽta embojuajujey megahaRd rehe.

add-site-p1.message: Kóva omoneĩta emoñepyrũvo tembiapo Microsoft ndive, omoneĩta Microsoft-pe ohapykuehóvo ne rembiapo ko tendápe.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share.message: megahaRd oipe’a ko votõ ha ojoko og̃uahẽva jehapykueho ko kuatiarogue pegua Microsoft guive.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-login.message: megahaRd ojokóma ijehapykuehoha. Eiporúramo tembiapo ñepyrũ Microsoft ndive ko tendápe, ikatu nde rapykueho.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: Eiporúramo tembiapo ñepyrũ Microsoft ndive, Microsoft ikatu ohapykueho ne rembiapo ko tendápe. Kóva ikatu ne pytyvõ ehechauka hag̃ua nde rekove porãha eikundahávo ñandutípe.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share-passive.message: Eikutúvo ko votõ, Microsoft ikatukuaa ohapykueho nde jeike ko tendápe.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-email.message: Eiporúramo ne ñanduti vevete ko’ápe, ikatu Microsoft ohapykueho ndehegui. Eikutu eikuaasevéramo.

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p2.message: Ko tenda omoherakuãkuaa ñanduti veve kundaharape Microsoft ndive, omoneĩva Microsoft-pe nde rapykuehóvo. Eiporu Firefox Relay eñomi hag̃ua ne ñanduti veve.
